places.name: Radhanagar Beach
places.description: Voted Asia's Best Beach by Time magazine, it offers a near-flawless combination of scenery, clean water, and atmosphere.
places.bestTime: October to May; sunsets are spectacular year-round

places.name: Cellular Jail National Memorial
places.description: A deeply moving memorial to India's independence struggle, essential for understanding the colonial era's brutality.
places.mapsSearch: Cellular Jail National Memorial Port Blair
places.bestTime: Morning visits are less crowded; evening for the sound-and-light show

places.name: Elephant Beach
places.description: The most accessible spot in the Andamans for world-class snorkelling without a diving certification.
places.bestTime: October to April, mornings for calmer water

places.name: Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep)
places.description: The Andamans' most laid-back island, perfect for travellers seeking solitude over spectacle.
places.mapsSearch: Neil Island Andaman and Nicobar Islands

places.name: Scuba Diving at Havelock Island
places.description: One of India's top scuba destinations with diverse marine life and excellent year-round visibility.
places.bestTime: December to April for best visibility

places.name: Ross Island (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Island)
places.description: An atmospheric open-air ruin-scape that vividly illustrates the island's colonial past.
places.bestTime: October to March, morning light is ideal for photography

places.name: Baratang Island Limestone Caves
places.description: A rare combination of tribal reserve passage, mangrove waterways, and dramatic cave formations in one journey.

places.name: North Bay Island
places.description: Ideal for families wanting a reef experience close to Port Blair with multiple water activity options.
places.mapsSearch: North Bay Island Port Blair Andaman

places.name: Kalapathar Beach
places.description: A pristine, crowd-free beach offering Havelock's most photogenic rock-and-sand contrast.
places.bestTime: Early morning for golden light on the black rocks

places.name: Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park, Wandoor
places.description: The Andamans' most protected and biodiverse marine habitat, with strictly managed visitor numbers.
places.mapsSearch: Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park Wandoor Andaman
places.bestTime: Jolly Buoy open November to May only

budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi
